description: This file defines synchronization primitives for wait-free read access, including the LeftRight class for lock-free read/write operations and a wrapper class for thread-safe access to data.

classes.name: IncrementRAII
classes.description: RAII helper for incrementing and decrementing an atomic counter.

classes.name: LeftRight
classes.description: A wait-free synchronization primitive allowing lock-free reads and synchronized writes.

classes.name: RWSafeLeftRightWrapper
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper around data, providing synchronized read/write access.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Performs a lock-free read operation using a provided function.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Performs a synchronized write operation using a provided function.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: Internal method handling the write logic with data swapping and synchronization.

methods.name: _callWriteFuncOnBackgroundInstance
methods.description: Executes the write function on the background data instance, with error recovery.

methods.name: _waitForBackgroundCounterToBeZero
methods.description: Waits until the specified background counter reaches zero.
